reproduction_rule: exact equality of every archived placement field, including dtype and geometry; mismatches INVALID, no tolerance adaptation
scoring_rule: cast live features/candidates to FP32 without renormalization; autocast and TF32 off, highest float32 matmul precision; one native matrix and transpose
scale_rule: one current-run original scale tensor; FP32 cast for head multiplication, live native connection, detached auxiliary scale; auxiliary similarities remain live
carrier_rule: one original D1 H_Synth call under unchanged D1 autocast, before head fork
target_rule: one unchanged v1 detached geometry construction and one ST candidate per arm shared by both heads
